requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as requested by the user. energy_score_class cannot separate C from D/E (both fall in score 3), so energy_class is used.

output.explanation: Filters residential property types with surface_area >= 140, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point. The capacity requirement of 18 people is not in the extracted requirements, so no predicate was added for it.
